title: The Portrait of Cold Spring
author: Elodie Dunmore
blurb: Isandro Fairweather, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
